set.pl: Clark place on Main St, Homer (1896 obituary); lot not yet fixed
pinev: Placed from the source text: GNIS Homer (village); he lived in an old barn in town

1896 obituary: he died in James A. Clark's wood-shed behind Clark's house on Main St, Homer, so the 'old barn' he lived in was at the Clark place on Main St; the lot could be fixed from an 1890s Homer Sanborn.
